sourceFile: 13. BRS-161016 Report check VP+CD waiting long time to Led UV afer bonding  28.4.2025_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft captures the report theme but misdefines the changed factor and includes misparsed non-comparison measurements.
issues: Changed factor should be waiting time before LED UV, not normal vs unspecified test.
Baseline and levels need regrouping across 17s normal, longer waits, and dry UV variants.
LED UV/bonding setup rows are controls, not outcome comparisons.
Picture/NG row appears misparsed as measurement data.
Vision outcome is incomplete if rows beyond 28 contain other wait-time levels.
correctionPlan: Rename changed factor to waiting time from VP+CD bonding/assembly to LED UV.
Set 17s normal as baseline only if supported; list each wait-time level as changed conditions.
Keep vision and tension as outcomes under the same factor, preserving row-level wait-time keys.
Move LED UV energy and bonding amount rows to process/setup context unless compared as conditions.
Remove misparsed picture-derived statistics or replace with citeable defect results rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but cited rows are not sufficient until grouping and misparsed outcomes are corrected.
